text: 臺北每 10 棟房子，有 9 棟超過 30 年。
text_en: In Taipei, 9 out of 10 buildings are over 30 years old.

text: 地震來了，先救誰？
text_en: When an earthquake hits, who do we help first?

text: 住戶怎麼辦？
text_en: And what can residents do?

text: 我們把高齡、老屋、液化、窄巷、軟弱層五件事放在一起，排出 456 個里誰先健檢。
text_en: We combined five factors: older residents, old buildings, liquefaction, narrow lanes, and soft stories, to rank 456 villages for safety checks.

text: 權重怎麼調，排名怎麼動，都看得到。
text_en: Change the weights, and you can see the ranking move.

text: 這個里每 100 人有 8 位超過 80 歲，9 條窄巷消防車進不去。
text_en: In this village, 8 in every 100 people are over 80, and fire trucks cannot get into 9 narrow lanes.

text: 里長拿著這張表，就知道先演練什麼。
text_en: With this sheet, the village chief knows what to drill first.

text: 輸入你家地址，看現在值多少、分回多少。
text_en: Enter your address to see what your home is worth now, and what you would get back.

text: 同一戶，用新成屋算是賺 539 萬，用真實都更案算是虧 429 萬。
text_en: For the same unit, new-home prices show a gain of NT$5.39 million; real renewal cases show a loss of NT$4.29 million.

text: 划不划算，看你信哪個單價。
text_en: Whether it pays depends on which price you trust.

text: 多出來的容積是一塊一塊疊上去的。
text_en: Extra floor area is stacked up, one block at a time.

text: 點一塊，告訴你為什麼、法源在哪。
text_en: Tap a block to see why, and which law allows it.

text: 全臺北最常拿的是好設計和留人行道。
text_en: Across Taipei, the most common bonuses are good design and space for sidewalks.

text: 同意書收到哪，大家看同一張板子。
text_en: Everyone sees one board showing which consent forms are in.

text: 差幾戶、誰要補掛號信、什麼時候可以撤銷，一目了然。
text_en: How many are missing, who needs a registered letter, and when consent can be withdrawn, all at a glance.

text: 100 棟老公寓，照現在的做法只有 13 棟過得了全體同意。
text_en: Out of 100 old apartment buildings, only 13 get everyone to agree the way things work now.

text: 講清楚分回、派個案經理，可以到 45 棟。
text_en: Explain the payback clearly and assign a case manager, and it can reach 45.

text: 都更要過 8 站、跨 4 個局處，光是送件到核定，中位數就要 2.7 年。
text_en: Urban renewal passes 8 stations across 4 departments. From filing to approval alone, the median is 2.7 years.

text: 我們把它畫成一張捷運圖，每一站誰負責、要多久。
text_en: We drew it as a metro map: who is in charge at each station, and how long it takes.

text: 都更後，屋頂可以不是鐵皮。
text_en: After renewal, the roof does not have to be sheet metal.

text: 拖一下，選你喜歡的樣子，按個讚，設計從住戶開始。
text_en: Drag to pick the look you like and give it a like. Design starts with residents.

text: 六個工具，一份公開資料。
text_en: Six tools, one set of open data.

text: 你是住戶、里長還是市府，選一個，我們幫你排路線。
text_en: Resident, village chief, or city staff? Pick one, and we will plan your route.
